units.source_text: 我回到安冈之后，那样令我失望的金阁，又一次在我心中逐渐复苏了它的美，

en.t: After I returned to Yasuoka, the Golden Pavilion that had disappointed me so deeply gradually revived its beauty in my heart once again,

units.source_text: 不知什么时候竟成了比我看见之前更美的金阁。

en.t: and before I knew it, it had become a Golden Pavilion more beautiful than it had been before I saw it.

units.source_text: 我说不出它什么地方美。

en.t: I could not say what exactly was beautiful about it.

units.source_text: 看来梦想中孕育着的东西，一旦经过现实的修正，反而变成刺激梦想了。

en.t: It seemed that something nurtured in dreams, once corrected by reality, instead became a stimulus to those dreams.
